_why: David retired the US State Department as a safety authority on 2026-08-18. Traveller-facing prose still cites it in this many places. The number may only go DOWN. It is a ratchet, not a target: erroring on all of them would paint validate:ingest red until 157 dossiers are rewritten by hand, and a permanently red gate is one people learn to pass with --no-verify. Lower this number as the claims are rewritten; the gate refuses any increase.
_rewritten_by: a human reading the FCDO, never a script. The alternative is what put a sentence State never wrote into a Cartagena consent screen.
_promise_note: Safety promises are ABSOLUTE — target 0, not a tolerance. Ratcheted only so a pre-existing set does not block unrelated work. Remedy is deletion of the claim, never a generated replacement.
_advisory_text_note: Hazards attributed to an advisory that does not name them, in FAQ answers. Target 0. Ratcheted only so a pre-existing set does not block unrelated work; a human rewrites from the source text or drops the claim.
